methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 widely-searched desktop laptop stands/risers spanning fixed single-piece stands (Rain Design mStand/iLevel2, Twelve South Curve/ParcSlope, Grovemade Laptop Stand), portable folding ergonomic risers (Roost V3, Nexstand K2, Nulaxy C1, BoYata N21, Lamicall Adjustable), one vertical laptop dock (UGREEN Adjustable Vertical), and one folding sit-stand desk (MOFT Z). Adversarially re-verified on 2026-08-19: every listed priceUsd was reconfirmed against the brand's own live product page where reachable (Rain Design mStand $49.90 and iLevel2 $64.90, Twelve South Curve $59.99, Roost V3 $89.95 MSRP now selling ~$69, Nexstand K2 $37.35, MOFT Z $69.99, Nulaxy C1 $36.99, Lamicall $39.99, BoYata N21 $30.99), and against reputable secondary sources where the brand page blocks automated fetches or was discontinued (Grovemade Laptop Stand $119 via Bless This Stuff, which quotes Grovemade's own copy; Twelve South ParcSlope $50 launch via Tools & Toys). No price was found to be fabricated and no product was invented, so nothing was removed. Two errors were corrected: ParcSlope releaseDate '2016' (the review's publish year, not the launch) was nulled, and the UGREEN vertical dock was reclassified from 'ergonomic' to 'vertical' with its unconfirmed height_adjustable nulled. Dimensions/heights are in inches, weight capacity in lb (converted from kg when a source published metric only); the four boolean specs record whether a mechanism exists at all, not its numeric range. Twelve South's official ParcSlope page has been removed from its current lineup, so that entry is sourced from a contemporaneous review plus a retail listing. UGREEN's US storefront had zero in-stock laptop stands, so that entry uses UGREEN's EU store with priceUsd left null rather than converted/guessed. accessedAt 2026-08-19.

products.name: Rain Design mStand

products.name: Twelve South ParcSlope
products.priceNote: original MSRP; discontinued from Twelve South's current lineup, still sold by some third-party retailers
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19. Twelve South's own ParcSlope product page is no longer live (discontinued from current lineup). Specs verified via Tools & Toys' contemporaneous review: single-piece aluminum with rubber pads, fixed 18° decline, 11-15 in / MacBook compatibility, $50 launch price, open cutout aiding cable management/cooling; cross-checked against a B&H Photo listing (SKU 12-1635) which is a real product page but blocked automated fetch. releaseDate corrected: the draft's '2016' was the review's publish year — the same review notes the ParcSlope shipped before the 12-inch MacBook's 2015 announcement, so 2016 is wrong and no exact launch year can be corroborated; set to null. products.name: UGREEN Adjustable Vertical Laptop Stand
products.priceNote: €28.99 on UGREEN's EU store (list €49.99); UGREEN's US laptop-stand collection showed no in-stock listing at data-pull time, so no verified USD MSRP
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19: UGREEN's EU storefront page is live and confirms the product name 'Adjustable Vertical Laptop Stand' and EU pricing (€28.99, list €49.99). Corrections vs draft: riser_type changed from 'ergonomic' to 'vertical' — this is a vertical laptop holder/dock (stores a closed laptop on its edge), not an ergonomic screen-raising riser; height_adjustable changed from true to null because the page confirms only that the product is 'adjustable' (vertical docks typically adjust base width for laptop thickness, not height) and HEIGHT adjustment cannot be corroborated. No USD price could be verified (US collection page showed zero in stock; third-party US retailer listings failed to load), so priceUsd left null rather than converted from EUR. Material, angle, foldability, size fit, capacity, and ventilation remain unverified and null.
